placements.title: Operational Execution and Reliability Standards

placements.title: Operational capabilities only exist when routinely rehearsed and validated
placements.frame: Does the expression treat operational capability and recovery mechanisms as non-existent unless verified through regular practice?
placements.why: Grounds the mandate for recurring Atlas rollback drills in the axiomatic principle that un-rehearsed operational safety mechanisms do not genuinely exist.
